items.title: Lillian Hardin Armstrong Interview, 1959-07-01
items.q: Minor Hall joined the band somewhere because he went to San Francisco with us.

ctx.x: No, no. We went to this ballroom in San Francisco and stayed six months. Then, we went across to Oakland and played at the cabaret for about two or three weeks. I don't remember the cabaret, but it was in Oakland. Then, after that, after that job closed, they decided to go to Los Angeles. Well, I was afraid to keep staying out there because I slipped off to go there anyway. I told my mother we were going somewhere to make a record. See, anyway, when she heard from me, I was in San Francisco. So, after that, I…

items.title: Minor "Ram" Hall Interview, 1958-09-02
items.q: So that wound up with Wilmer Breaux, Sugar Johnny, Lawrence Dewey, Roy Palmer, myself and Lil Hardin.

ctx.x: You were too young to get them involved.

Yeah, I wasn't quite old enough yet for the first draft. So when he went, I'd taken over, and in the meantime, I don't know what happened to Tuley Garland, but when I wound up, Breaux was playing bass, Wilmer Breaux. So that wound up with Wilmer Breaux, Sugar Johnny, Lawrence Dewey, Roy Palmer, myself and Lil Hardin. See, she was then Hardin, it wasn't Armstrong's right there.
